plain: A former CIA official named Glenn Gaffney is said to have blocked a transfer of UFO material from the defence company Lockheed Martin to the space company Bigelow Aerospace. Michels tells this in 2026, saying a couple of people made the claim, one of them under oath in front of Congress. If true, it would mean crashed-craft material sits with private companies and officials decide who gets it.
